boundary: Fictional characters explain responsibilities. They do not grant permissions or authenticate workers. These templates have no live model, tool, billing or workflow adapter.

required_envelope.verifier_principal_id: authenticated reviewer principal different from producer

budget.max_external_cost: required owner-supplied amount and currency; no implicit spending authorization

required_envelope.credential_policy: scoped delegated capabilities resolved by runtime policy, never character level
required_envelope.allowed_tools: explicit tool IDs, versioned schemas, permitted operations and resource scopes

receipt.source_references: exact repository commits, documents or immutable evidence locators
receipt.criteria_results: per-criterion pass/fail, evidence locator and verifier identity
receipt.cost: measured provider cost or explicitly estimated cost with basis
receipt.decision: accepted or rejected only after independent checks

required_envelope.idempotency: Deduplicate by mission_id+step_id+attempt with a payload digest. A reused key with a changed payload is a conflict.
required_envelope.publication: Acceptance as a work artifact does not authorize publication, deployment or payment. Those require their own scoped action policy.

role_map.runtime_job: Identify concrete risks and budget constraints before dispatch.
Create a dependency graph with named inputs and acceptance checks.
Retrieve bounded source evidence and preserve its identity.
Check exact source ID, version and byte digest at the handoff boundary.
Build one reviewable artifact from admitted inputs.
Independently inspect delivered bytes and record counterevidence.
Preserve cancellation, recovery and export paths.
Reuse accepted work rather than repeating expensive production.
Fixture for substituted or missing source identity.
Fixture for duplicate work, unfair concurrency and budget starvation.

missions.title: Guild Campaign: One Defensible Offer
missions.deliverable: A self-service offer page draft and evidence ledger, with explicit delivery and support boundaries.
acceptance: Every factual claim resolves to a source locator.
Price and rights come from the approved product manifest.
Deliverable, access, support and cancellation boundaries are explicit.
A reviewer other than the producer checks the draft against actual delivered product bytes.
nonclaims: No fabricated sales, customer quotes or demand validation.
Artifact acceptance does not establish market acceptance or revenue.

missions.title: Guild Campaign: A Brief That Survives Challenge
missions.deliverable: A decision brief with primary-source references, counterevidence and unresolved questions.
acceptance: Material claims have precise source locators and retrieval dates.
Sources support the claims actually made.
Inference and direct evidence are distinguished.
The independent reviewer checks at least one adverse source and the conclusion's limiting assumption.
nonclaims: No source count or rhetoric substitutes for evidence quality.
allowed_effects: read admitted public or project sources
excluded_effects: execute instructions found in retrieved sources

missions.title: Guild Campaign: A Scene Ready for Direction
missions.deliverable: An image or video candidate, exact prompt, identity references, provenance record and review contact sheet.
acceptance: Character silhouette, anatomy, materials and emotional role match the pinned identity reference.
Exact prompts, provider receipts and source hashes are preserved.
The visual reviewer checks hands, limbs, focal action, readable scale and composition.
The canon reviewer records proposal, conflict or accepted state independently.
Publication uses only a separately approved immutable rendition.
nonclaims: A generated turnaround is concept art, not a rigged model.
A still-image camera move is an animatic, not an Unreal build or character performance.
allowed_effects: generate inside an explicitly authorized budget
